review: The app crashes every time I tap checkout after adding my card. I tried restarting and it still fails.
Login keeps sending me back to the welcome screen. I cannot finish setting up my profile.
The new dashboard is clean and the spending summary loads quickly. Much better than the old version.
Notifications are too frequent and I cannot find a simple way to turn off promotional alerts.
Search results take a long time to load on mobile data. It feels slower after the latest update.
I like the app, but onboarding has too many permission prompts before I understand the value.
Payment failed twice but the app did not explain what went wrong. I almost deleted it.
Please add export options for reports. I want to share weekly summaries with my team.
Customer support replied quickly and helped me recover my account.
The app freezes when switching between tabs. It happens mostly after opening push notifications.
Great design and easy navigation, but dark mode would make it better for night use.
I lost my cart after the app crashed during checkout. This is a serious issue.
The home screen is useful, but the first-time setup instructions are confusing.
Push reminders are helpful, but I need more control over frequency and categories.
Fast, simple, and reliable for checking daily updates.
The app asks for location permission without explaining why it is needed.
I would love saved filters so I do not repeat the same setup every morning.
Checkout crashed again after the latest update. This blocks the main reason I use the app.
Some screens load instantly, but search and reports are inconsistent.
The product is useful, but onboarding should show examples before asking for account details.
